title: Acerb
summary: ACERB', adjective [Latin acerbus; G. herbe, harsh, sour, tart, bitter, rough, whence herbst autumn, herbstzeit, harvest time. See Harvest.] Sour, bitter, and harsh to the taste; sour, with astringency

inlines.v: ACERB', adjective [Latin acerbus; G. herbe, harsh, sour, tart, bitter, rough, whence herbst autumn, herbstzeit, harvest time. See Harvest.] Sour, bitter, and harsh to the taste; sour, with astringency or roughness; a quality of unripe fruits.
